title: AgentLens: Adaptive Visual Modalities for Human-Agent Interaction in Mobile GUI Agents
abstract: arXiv:2604.20279v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Mobile GUI agents can automate smartphone tasks by interacting directly with app interfaces, but how they should communicate with users during execution remains underexplored. Existing systems rely on two extremes: foreground execution, which maximizes transparency but prevents multitasking, and background execution, which supports multitasking but provides little visual awareness. Through iterative formative studies, we found that users prefer a hybrid model with just-in-time visual interaction, but the most effective visualization modality depends on the task. Motivated by this, we present AgentLens, a mobile GUI agent that adaptively uses three visual modalities during human-agent interaction: Full UI, Partial UI, and GenUI. AgentLens extends a standard mobile agent with adaptive communication actions and uses Virtual Display to enable background execution with selective visual overlays. translated_title: AgentLens：移动GUI智能体中人机交互的自适应视觉模态
translated_abstract: 移动GUI智能体可以通过直接与应用界面交互来自动化智能手机任务，但它们在执行过程中应如何与用户沟通仍未得到充分探索。现有系统依赖两个极端：前台执行最大化了透明度但阻碍了多任务处理，而后台执行支持多任务处理但几乎不提供视觉感知。通过迭代的形成性研究，我们发现用户偏好带有即时视觉交互的混合模型，但最有效的可视化模态取决于具体任务。受此启发，我们提出了AgentLens，这是一个在人机交互过程中自适应使用三种视觉模态（完整UI、部分UI和生成式UI）的移动GUI智能体。AgentLens通过自适应通信动作扩展了标准移动智能体，并使用虚拟显示技术实现后台执行与选择性视觉叠加。在一项有21名参与者参与的对照研究中……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出AgentLens，一种能够根据任务在人机交互中自适应切换完整UI、部分UI和生成式UI三种视觉模态的移动GUI智能体，借助虚拟显示技术实现后台执行与选择性视觉叠加，兼顾执行透明度与多任务处理。
en_tdlr: AgentLens is a mobile GUI agent that adaptively switches among three visual modalities (Full UI, Partial UI, and GenUI) depending on the task, using Virtual Display to enable background execution with selective visual overlays, balancing execution transparency with multitasking.
